<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/campaign/start"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Used by `hackagent campaign run FILE`. Saves the file's campaign, by name among the organization's CLI campaigns (a dashboard campaign of the same name is left alone), and creates its campaign run already claimed by the caller: status `RUNNING`, executor `cli`. The caller then executes it like any executor, with heartbeats, child runs, results and a final `finish`. The agent must belong to the caller's organization.
